children: Incorporated on November 15, 2019, Jio Platforms Limited is a technology company focused on digital connectivity, digital services and technologyled solutions in India. The Company has built a comprehensive digital ecosystem supported by proprietary technology capabilities and pan-India connectivity infrastructure, enabling it to deliver integrated digital services to both consumers and businesses. Its subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm Limited, served 533.3 million customers as of June 30, 2026, providing a substantial customer base for the expansion of its digital offerings. Jio Platforms operates through an integrated technology platform spanning digital connectivity, consumer applications, enterprise solutions, cloud services, Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI). Its consumer portfolio includes mobile and fixed broadband services, digital entertainment, cloud storage, virtual PC services and smart home solutions. On the enterprise side, the Company offers connectivity, cloud and security solutions, managed services, IoT applications and AI-based solutions, catering to the evolving technology requirements of businesses. Its proprietary technology capabilities extend across network infrastructure, device engineering, software, operating systems and digital applications, supporting the development and delivery of integrated digital solutions.

At the upper issue price, the company is valued at 34.3x FY2026 P/E and 14.8x FY2026 EV/EBITDA, implying a market capitalization of approximately ₹10,304,905 million. Considering its leadership position in India's digital ecosystem, strong profitability, scalable technology platform, robust growth prospects and significant opportunities in AI, enterprise digital services and fixed broadband, the valuation appears reasonable relative to its long-term growth potential.
